result.title: HexIt: Learning Hexahedral Block Decomposition with Expert Iteration on Combinatorial Maps
result.summary: Decomposing a polyhedral solid into a few well-shaped hexahedral blocks is a long-standing open problem in mesh generation. We cast it as a sequential decision problem on a 3-dimensional generalised map: an agent splits edges, faces and volumes with three insert operations until every cell is a hexahedron and the mesh passes a quality threshold, and a policy that convolves over the map's involutions chooses each insert. A successful decomposition takes over a hundred decisions, and a uniformly random policy never finds one. We clone a policy from constructed decompositions and improve it by expert iteration. On held-out chamfered solids that share no boundary topology with the cloning data, the final policy solves an expected $94.4\%$ in $20$ samples, and expert iteration raises the best-of-20 solve rate on large chamfered solids from $0.203$ to $0.355$. At matched compute, PPO, GRPO and VinePPO updates all make the cloned policy worse.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文将多面体分解为若干高质量六面体块的问题表述为 3D generalized map 上的序贯决策：在 map 的 involution 上卷积的策略依次选择插入边、面、体的操作，先由构造解克隆策略，再用 expert iteration 改进，并报告同算力下 PPO、GRPO、VinePPO 更新反而使克隆策略变差。
AI.relevance_reason: 上百步长时程、成功样本稀疏下的「构造轨迹克隆 + 迭代改进」及其 RL 更新导致性能退化的负结果，可能为 LVR 中的轨迹监督、贡献分配与 RL 微调风险提供旁证线索，但任务与视觉语言推理无直接关联，需较多核查。
